comment: Order is load order. The runtime must come first, styles before the app renders, labels before anything calls OB.UIKit.t.
writesComment: Safe to replay: AckAlert is idempotent, so the armed POST that W7 sends on every run answers success with changed:false once the row is already ACKNOWLEDGED. The id is instance data on purpose -- W7 needs a leg that really succeeds, and a placeholder id would be refused by the scoped re-read and fail the gate. It is the G/L ITEM WITHOUT ACCOUNTING alert, the one alert whose rule lists the F&B International Group Admin role as a recipient; alerts are regenerable by the alert process, which is what makes writing to one safe here and nowhere else in the kit.
checksComment: Gates propios: los recuentos del carril son identicos con y sin filtro y cuadran con un count(*) independiente, el detalle estrecha de verdad en SQL comparando conjuntos de ids, el filtro de destinatario recorta lo visible para un rol no administrador que entra por HTTP, la escritura va y vuelve en la base y se restaura, y la transicion prohibida se rechaza con sobre de error en lugar de un 500.
